Simulate a multi-omics data set with known latent factors

Source: R/simulate.R
simulate_multiomics.Rd

Generates several omics views that share a small number of latent factors. The first factors separate the sample groups, so a good factor method should recover the groups, and only a sparse subset of features in each view carries signal, so feature-level recovery can also be scored.

Usage

simulate_multiomics(
  n_samples = 60,
  views = c(transcriptome = 200, metabolome = 80, microbiome = 50),
  n_groups = 3,
  n_factors = 3,
  n_group_factors = 2,
  effect = 2.5,
  sparsity = 0.2,
  noise = 1,
  seed = 21
)

Arguments

n_samples

Integer. Number of samples (default 60).

views

Named integer vector giving the number of features per view.

n_groups

Integer. Number of sample groups (default 3).

n_factors

Integer. Number of true latent factors (default 3).

n_group_factors

Integer. How many of the factors are shifted by group (default 2). The remaining factors are continuous nuisance variation.

effect

Numeric. Distance of each group centroid from the origin on the group factors (default 2.5).

sparsity

Numeric in (0, 1]. Fraction of features in each view loaded on each factor (default 0.2).

noise

Numeric. Standard deviation of the Gaussian noise (default 1).

seed

Integer random seed, or NULL (default 21).

Value

A list with

data

Named list of features x samples matrices.

metadata

Data frame with sample, group, batch and age.

truth

List with the true scores Z, loadings W (per view), and feature_labels, a named 0/1 vector flagging signal features ("view::feature" names).

Examples

sim <- simulate_multiomics(n_samples = 30, seed = 1)
str(sim$data)
#> List of 3
#>  $ transcriptome: num [1:200, 1:30] -0.155 1.709 1.992 0.316 -3.889 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:200] "gene_001" "gene_002" "gene_003" "gene_004" ...
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:30] "S001" "S002" "S003" "S004" ...
#>  $ metabolome   : num [1:80, 1:30] -0.513 1.8 -0.924 -1.555 3.274 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:80] "met_001" "met_002" "met_003" "met_004" ...
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:30] "S001" "S002" "S003" "S004" ...
#>  $ microbiome   : num [1:50, 1:30] -3.149 -0.309 -5.352 -2.73 -0.165 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:50] "otu_001" "otu_002" "otu_003" "otu_004" ...
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:30] "S001" "S002" "S003" "S004" ...
table(sim$metadata$group)
#> 
#> G1 G2 G3 
#> 10 10 10
